subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas com funções logarítmicas nos quais seja necessário compreender e interpretar a variação das grandezas envolvidas, em contextos como os de abalos sísmicos, pH, radioatividade, Matemática Financeira, entre outros.

components.description_pt: Interpretar a variação de quantidades modeladas por funções logarítmicas
components.description_en: Interpret the variation of quantities modeled by logarithmic functions
components.cc_component_description: Graph logarithmic functions, showing intercepts and end behavior

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas envolvendo funções logarítmicas em contextos reais como pH ou atividade sísmica
components.description_en: Solve problems involving logarithmic functions in real-world contexts such as pH or seismic activity
components.cc_component_description: Use the inverse relationship between exponential and logarithmic functions to solve problems

components.description_pt: Criar problemas que exigem o uso de funções logarítmicas para modelar situações contextuais
components.description_en: Create problems that require the use of logarithmic functions to model contextual situations
components.cc_component_description: Create exponential equations in one variable in a contextual situation

components.description_pt: Aplicar funções logarítmicas a contextos de matemática financeira e radioatividade
components.description_en: Apply logarithmic functions to financial mathematics and radioactivity contexts
components.cc_component_description: Use the inverse relationship between exponential and logarithmic functions to solve problems

cc_matches.description: (+) Understand the inverse relationship between exponents and logarithms and use this relationship to solve problems involving logarithms and exponents.
Graph exponential and logarithmic functions, showing intercepts and end behavior, and trigonometric functions, showing period, midline, and amplitude.
Create equations and inequalities in one variable and use them to solve problems. Include equations arising from linear and quadratic functions, and simple rational and exponential functions.

prerequisites.description_pt: Efetuar cálculos com potências de expoentes inteiros e aplicar esse conhecimento na representação de números em notação científica.
